WORK LIST
=========
A small floating ball that stays on top of your screen. Click it to open your
to-do list: add tasks, set the day you'll work on them and their deadline, and
filter by "Do today", "Due today" and "Overdue".

Works on Windows 10 and 11. Nothing else needs to be installed.


INSTALL
-------
1. Double-click WorkList-Setup.exe.
2. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click "More info", then
   "Run anyway". (This appears because the app isn't from a big publisher
   that pays for a code-signing certificate.)
3. Choose whether it should start when you sign in, then click Install.

The ball appears near the top-right corner of your screen. Work List is also
in the Start menu. It installs for your Windows account only, so you don't
need admin rights.


USING IT
--------
- Click the ball to open or close the list. Drag the ball to move it.
- Type a task and press Enter. Use "Work on" and "Due" below the box to set dates.
- Under "Due", choose "Pick date & time..." to set an exact time. Then use
  "Remind me" to choose when you get a pop-up in the bottom-right corner:
  at the due time, or 5 min / 15 min / 30 min / 1 hour / 2 hours / 1, 2, 3 or 5 days /
  1 week before.
- To change a task, double-click it (or right-click > Edit). Change anything at
  the top, then press Enter or click Save. Esc or Cancel leaves it unchanged.
  (Reminders only appear while Work List is running. Ones you miss show up the next time it starts.)
- Click the circle next to a task to mark it done. Hover over a task and click
  the x to delete it. Right-click a task for more options.
- The number on the ball is how many tasks you need to do or turn in today.
  A red dot means something is overdue.
- The "..." button has "Clear finished tasks", "Move ball back to the corner"
  and "Quit".


UNINSTALL
---------
Settings > Apps > Installed apps > Work List > "..." > Uninstall
(On Windows 10: Settings > Apps > Work List > Uninstall)

You'll be asked whether to also delete your saved tasks. If you say No, they
come back if you install Work List again.


WHERE THINGS ARE
----------------
App:          %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\WorkList
Your tasks:   %APPDATA%\WorkList\tasks.json
